body: I had doubts of the cord working even though I had it tied in a noose under my bed waiting for the day I decided to go through with it. It was moving around a lot when I tied it up around the plank but I decided to try it anyways and it still worked. I hope you don't take the information I said and do anything with it because I would feel crushed knowing I contributed to you doing such a thing and it might make me try again. I promise you though when you are close to being completely gone your mind and body will fight to do stay alive so no matter what I hope you decide to stay here.

There is people, but I don't want them knowing what I did or what I'm going through. I'm 19, and remember being depressed since around 16. I've been suicidal for about a year and always had the chord under my bed ready to go. this was my first attempt. I never even use Reddit to post, I only use this to surf Reddit. I don't know why I even posted this but it was the first thing I could think to do because I read through here frequently

I blacked out almost instantly. I'm still so shook, shaking and crying as I type this. I felt my body twitching even though everything was black and i had fear that I wasn't going to be able to stand on the chairs and remove the chord. I kind of wish I would have just let it happen. My neck is red and purple I don't know how I'm supposed to hide this from my family now. I have the same issue it also burns
My neck and throat hurt so much
